Query the GLASS product registry

Source: R/glass_registry.R
glass_registry.Rd

glass_registry() returns the bundled glass_products registry, optionally filtered. glass_product_info() returns one or a few rows and errors loudly when the lookup is ambiguous, so it is handy for interactive use.

Usage

glass_registry(product = NULL, variant_id = NULL, verified_only = FALSE)

glass_product_info(variant_id = NULL, product = NULL)

Arguments

product

Product directory name(s) under /archive/, e.g. "LAI". In glass_registry(), NULL keeps all products.

variant_id

Optional exact variant key(s), e.g. "LAI_MODIS_250M".

verified_only

If TRUE, return only variants whose file naming and band metadata were verified against a sample granule.

Value

A tibble of registry rows (see glass_products for columns).

Examples

glass_registry("LAI")
#> # A tibble: 8 × 21
#>   product long_name     variant_id source res   layout observed_years start_year
#>   <chr>   <chr>         <chr>      <chr>  <chr> <chr>  <chr>               <dbl>
#> 1 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_AVHRR  AVHRR  NA    year_… 1981-2018            1981
#> 2 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_HR_LA… HR_LAI V01   flat   NA                     NA
#> 3 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  0.05D year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> 4 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  0.1D  year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> 5 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  0.25D year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> 6 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  0.5D  year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> 7 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  250M  year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> 8 LAI     Leaf Area In… LAI_MODIS… MODIS  500M  year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> # ℹ 13 more variables: end_year <dbl>, cadence_days <int>, temporal_res <chr>,
#> #   version <chr>, code <chr>, layer <chr>, fill_value <dbl>,
#> #   scale_factor <dbl>, valid_min <dbl>, valid_max <dbl>, verified <lgl>,
#> #   url_root <chr>, notes <chr>
glass_product_info("NDVI_MODIS_250M")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 21
#>   product long_name     variant_id source res   layout observed_years start_year
#>   <chr>   <chr>         <chr>      <chr>  <chr> <chr>  <chr>               <dbl>
#> 1 NDVI    Normalized D… NDVI_MODI… MODIS  250M  year_… 2000-2025            2000
#> # ℹ 13 more variables: end_year <dbl>, cadence_days <int>, temporal_res <chr>,
#> #   version <chr>, code <chr>, layer <chr>, fill_value <dbl>,
#> #   scale_factor <dbl>, valid_min <dbl>, valid_max <dbl>, verified <lgl>,
#> #   url_root <chr>, notes <chr>
